Slop Orders · Beta

Orders

Customers, products and orders. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Slop Orders has these main features: Draft, confirm, fulfil or cancel; Fulfilment takes stock out.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Orders

  • Simple order management for a small business
  • Print a delivery note or packing slip
